stories.title: A wall collapsed on a man in Padeswood, one of two rescues for NEWSAR on Father’s Day
stories.summary: North East Wales Search and Rescue volunteers responded to two separate incidents on Father’s Day Sunday, including a man injured when a wall collapsed onto him in Padeswood. stories.title: Fire at Widnes waste site declared major incident, smoke visible from Deeside
stories.summary: A large fire at a waste facility in Widnes is producing a heavy smoke plume visible from Deeside, with Cheshire Fire and Rescue Service declaring a major incident 6pm on Monday 22 June. stories.title: Connah’s Quay teen to fly to USA to compete for Great Britain in inline hockey
stories.summary: A 13-year-old from Connah’s Quay has been selected to represent Great Britain in inline hockey and will travel to the United States in July to compete in two tournaments. stories.title: Public Health Wales issues extreme heat advice for Wales as amber warning covers Deeside through Thursday
stories.summary: Public Health Wales has issued an urgent call for people to look out for one another as north Wales faces a period of extreme heat, with an amber warning in place for Deeside from Wednesday midnight through to Thursday night. stories.title: Seven-month road closures and National Grid works among Flintshire’s roadworks this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire are facing road closures and temporary traffic lights at dozens of locations this week, with three roads in Penyffordd closed for water works that are scheduled to run until January 2027.
